transcript: Speaker A: क्यों नहीं हो पा रहा इंग्लिश बोलना? [Why are you unable to speak English?] Speaker B: सब इतना जल्दी बोलते हैं, मैं समझ नहीं पाता। [Everyone speaks so fast, I can't understand.] Speaker A: I will speak with you at a speed that you are comfortable with. And prepare you to speak confidently. Speaker B: पर तुम हो कौन? [But who are you?] Speaker A: मैं हूँ रीवा, तुम्हारी एआई इंग्लिश टीचर। पी डब्लू टॉक ऐप डाउनलोड करो और मेरे साथ बात करो। [I am Reeva, your AI English teacher. Download the PW Talk app and talk to me.] Speaker B: उससे क्या होगा? [What will happen with that?] Speaker A: मैं तुम्हें फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश बोलना सिखा दूँगी। इंग्लिश में फ्लूएंसी तभी आती है जब साथ में प्रैक्टिस करने के लिए कोई हो। और वो चांस मैं तुम्हें दूँगी। तुम्हें जितनी गलती करना है करो, मैं जज नहीं करती। I'll correct you and help you learn. मुझसे दिन में 10 मिनट बात करो। डेली कन्वर्सेशंस इंग्लिश में करने की प्रैक्टिस करो और महीने भर में देखो मैं तुम्हें कहाँ से कहाँ लेके जाती हूँ। [I will teach you to speak fluent English. Fluency in English only comes when there is someone to practice with. And I will give you that chance. Make as many mistakes as you want, I don't judge. I'll correct you and help you learn. Talk to me for 10 minutes a day. Practice daily conversations in English and see where I take you in a month.]

summary: A man struggles to speak English because others speak too fast. A futuristic AI hologram named Reeva introduces herself as his AI English teacher on the PW Talk app. She promises to practice with him at his own pace, correct his mistakes without judgment, and build his fluency in a month.
